answer: Bind reward eligibility to certified secure hardware, not account names. If timber, walnut and lotus run on one chip, its non-exportable key produces the same epoch pseudonym for all three, so they share one earning quota. Verify manufacturer attestations and revoke compromised chip batches. Extra accounts gain nothing; extra quotas require extra physical devices. Keep the quota below device rental costs to make a hardware farm uneconomic. This raises attack costs, not proof of personhood.
